title: app-shell: Studio and Console pass the held package id on MetadataService reads and editors (ADR-0150 child U)

Filing gate: ④ coordination node: child U of the epic #31527 (parent and per-layer children), as ADR-0150 (`docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md`, merged in #31586 at 5d1382a5)'s execution plan lists it. Business reason: inherited from the parent #31527. Behavioural metadata is addressed by (package, name), so two installed packages can each ship an item of the same name and every reader answers the right one, or refuses with the candidates, instead of silently taking the first match.
Reader: the next ui-lane seat in this repo picks it from the queue and accepts its PR against the red lines below.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `MetadataService packageId` (38; top hits #21899(closed) #23297(closed) #22024(closed), none on point: they are this epic, its parent #30806, or unrelated cards).
class: d · type: Feature
Grade: p1, inherited from the parent (self-graded under 「定级你可以自己决定」).

## 维护者速读

Studio 和控制台读取、编辑元数据时带上当前软件包 id（?package=X），这样同名元数据不会读错包。在服务端 G1 落地之前，这一步不改变任何返回结果。

## What to build

Studio and Console pass the package id they hold through `MetadataService` reads and editors (D5). On the wire it travels as `?package=X` (`client.meta.getItem`), which is the exact qualifier (D5, D2 ruling 6724570466), never a closure caller. The ~ten reads that go bare today go qualified.

## Surface

- Expected file surface: `ui/packages/app-shell` (`services/MetadataService.ts`, `views/studio-design/*`).
- Clause-②: no.
- Narrowing: yes, once G1 lands: a qualified read of a name X does not hold is refused naming the holders (not measurable first-party). U before G1 narrows nothing.

## Acceptance — the epic's three red lines (every child shares them)

- **Resolution never loosens.** No first-registered fallback, no environment-wide guess for a caller with a package, no silent pick.
- **Ambiguity is reported, never guessed.** Every refusal and every migration report names every candidate.
- **Independently releasable** (red line 3). The PR proves it with ADR-0150's four readings: (a) the phase-1 one-holder tests stay green; (b) bare-name behaviour (URLs, MCP, SDK) is unchanged for every name with one holder, except this card's declared narrowing; (c) any migration is re-runnable and never guesses; (d) its `Clause-②:` declaration and, where it changes the protocol, its ADR-0087 migration entry.
- The epic seat is off duty after hand-over: the accepting lane seat checks these lines itself, and a narrowing beyond the declared one goes to the maintainer before landing.

Parent: #31527.
